StatusLIVE WORKING DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder and management control board for formal customer and supplier communication, release discipline, response deadlines, institutional follow-through, and containment-aligned outward messaging.
Source ruleUpdate live communication packets, release checklists, transmittals, correspondence records, executable-check control board, executive scenario and contingency review, executive risk register, and linked functional control records first, then refresh this board.
Decision ruleIf a counterparty communication affects pricing, payment, shipment release, legal posture, claims, compliance timing, or contained movement, link it to the relevant control record before treating the message as complete.

Board HeaderLink

FieldCurrent Answer
Date2026-05-02
CycleWeekly founder communication control refresh
OwnerFounder office with commercial, operations, compliance, and finance control owners
Main communication priorityKeep Atlantic Foods and Golden Harvest outward messages controlled, deadline-specific, and aligned with live movement gates.
Main counterparty riskResponse silence or soft wording could widen pricing validity, shipment release confidence, payment posture, or complaint closure before proof is current.
Escalation postureStage-1 controlled follow-up is active; stage-2 founder visibility triggers if acknowledgment, deposit timing, supplier confirmation, CAPA proof, or recovery response slips.
Institutional quality postureFormal, specific, route-backed, deadline-led, and free of casual commitment language.
Movement-posture controlAll outward wording stays inside EXECCHK-2026-001, SCEN-2026-005, RISK-2026-008, FUND-2026-001, and REL-2026-001 until same-day revalidation allows a wider message.
